title: CLARITY Act More Complex Than Stablecoin Bill, Coinbase Says
summary: Coinbase institutional chief tells CNBC that comprehensive crypto market structure legislation faces extended negotiations over DeFi oversight and token standards, but competitive pressure from Europe's MiCA framework and talent flight will drive congressional action in 2026.The postCLARITY Act More Complex Than Stablecoin Bill, Coinbase Saysappeared first onCryptonews.
